horizontal registers/bands stacked one above another
figures holding staffs/objects in outstretched hands
decorative horizontal border band separating registers

justification: Both surfaces carve profile human figures in shallow relief, stacked in horizontal registers separated by ruled bands, with quadrupeds and hand-held objects appearing among the figures. But the depicted content differs: A combines a winged disc over dense rows of script signs with small seated/offering groups facing one another, while B shows a long uniform procession of standing attendants and led animals with rosette borders and no writing.
